item.title: Ucrania lanzó uno de sus mayores ataques aéreos sobre Rusia: al menos 13 muertos en una lluvia de drones
item.description: Con cientos de drones y misiles, Kiev efectuó este domingo un inédito ataque masivo contra la región de Moscú y el sur de Rusia, que provocó la muerte de al menos 11 personas. item.title: Tell HN: Cloudflare silently injects its analytics when you switch nameservers
item.description: A few hours ago I switched my nameservers to Cloudflare in order to enable R2 bucket serving through my own subdomain, and I found out that it silently had injected a JS analytics snippet in my HTML-only JS-free site textlog.cc — I had to go to the Analytics dashboard, Add the site to the analytics and then disable the snippet. I find this approach entirely invasive, you should opt-in to features like that not have to opt-out. Just a warning out there to folks who might not be aware of this.
